svg.aria-label: Four hops in a row: buy episode at the store API, entitlement in the rights service, playback through the player and CDN, billing in the ledger. Under each, the assertions: order id and price, entitlement for the right user and episode, a working stream, one charge of the correct amount.
svg.text: a journey test asserts at every hop, not just the first status code
a unit test checks one box. this test checks the whole chain.
